facts.fact: Arcep's audit mission of May 2025 found mobile subscribers identified with the Numero national d'identification (NNI): 21.77% of Airtel's 7,879,796 identified subscribers and 43.96% of Moov Africa's 7,509,196.
Arcep reports figures from its May 2025 audit: 21.77% of Airtel and 43.96% of Moov Africa identified subscribers were registered with the NNI.
